detail.longDescription: DeepSeek's dsh-superagent (MIT, Oct 31) runs commands "without approval as the operator's OS user". A gate decides who may start work, but once a ticket is open, every message on its thread, bot and CI comments too, reaches the worker as context. The gate limits authority, not what the model reads. https:// github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-sup eragent-prototype For a live view of an unattended agent's terminal, we built https:// shell.online # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # OpenSource
